name: When should I call a professional for a wind-damaged roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a wind-damaged roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for a wind-damaged roof inspection as soon as you suspect damage, especially after a significant storm with high winds. Early inspection helps identify issues before they lead to more extensive problems like water leaks. Even if damage isn't immediately visible from the ground, a professional can safely assess the entire roof and provide a detailed report on its condition and necessary repairs. Prompt action can prevent minor damage from becoming a major issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately after a strong wind event or if you notice any potential damage. Early inspection prevents minor issues from escalating.
